selection: 35 Oral/Spotlight candidates; 10 selected here, plus OPSD and SDPO from the earlier distillation shortlist.

candidates.title: DistiLLM-2: A Contrastive Approach Boosts the Distillation of LLMs
modules: 教师回答上的 skew KL 与学生回答上的 skew reverse KL
两路回答损失的加权聚合与课程参数

toy.description: 用小词表、教师与学生各自产生的两组回答展示两路蒸馏梯度；未确认论文有同样的独立 CPU toy。

harness: 两路散度不能交换；与逐词表独立公式比较
混合分布归一化、系数边界与 padding 不变性
教师无梯度，学生两路均有正确梯度
candidates.scope_note: 区别于已有 GKD 的单路学生 rollout；保留论文 Eq.2 及 §3.1 的两路机制，数据生成和训练循环由平台提供。

candidates.title: Advantage-Guided Distillation for Preference Alignment in Small Language Models
modules: DPO 教师与 reference 教师的对数概率比优势
学生分布下的优势期望及 SFT 联合目标

toy.description: 用三动作分布观察 DPO 教师相对 reference 的偏好变化如何影响学生；教学改编，不声称原文 Figure 3 概念图已有可运行脚本。

harness: 两教师相同时优势项为零
学生分布加权，不以教师概率加权；和显式求和 oracle 一致
冻结两教师；mask、目标符号及 SFT 权重边界
candidates.scope_note: 论文 Eq.8–10；强调相对教师的偏好增量，与普通复制教师分布区分。

candidates.title: TROLL: Trust Regions improve Reinforcement Learning for Large Language Models
modules: 离散概率分布的 KL 信赖域投影
投影的隐式梯度与约束激活边界

toy.description: 原文 Figure 1 有三 token 概率单纯形示意；据此做可交互投影实验。原文图示来源明确，但数值实例和 CPU 实现仍是教学改编。

harness: 概率非负且和为一；投影到旧分布的 KL 不超过 epsilon
原分布可行时不变；epsilon=0 时回到旧分布
与低维约束优化 oracle 比较；隐式梯度用有限差分验证，避免在不可微边界误用 gradcheck
candidates.scope_note: 首版只取严格正概率的小词表，数值对偶求解器可提供；须实现论文投影，不能用普通 PPO ratio clip 替代。大词表稀疏化后置。

candidates.title: Pass@K Policy Optimization: Solving Harder Reinforcement Learning Problems
modules: 稳定的 pass@k 估计与样本奖励变换
leave-one-out 基线和多样本梯度估计

toy.description: 原文 §5.1/Figure 1 的一维 Gaussian policy：标准差 0.1，区间 [0,1] 内奖励 x²、区间外为 0。缩减采样量，展示 k 对目标、梯度和方差的影响。

harness: 枚举小 n 的所有 k 子集，与闭式估计比较
k=1、k=n、全零/全一奖励与数值稳定性
精确小状态分布的期望梯度；基线不能依赖被排除样本；统计展示使用固定种子和校准阈值
candidates.scope_note: 核心是训练奖励/梯度变换，不仅是 Codex 的 pass@k 评测公式；不承诺每个 toy 同时提高 pass@1 和 pass@k。

candidates.title: Representation Alignment for Generation: Training Diffusion Transformers Is Easier Than You Think
modules: Patch-wise representation alignment loss
Denoising loss plus frozen-teacher feature alignment

toy.description: Tiny noisy patch features and fixed clean teacher embeddings; compare projection alignment before/after a short CPU optimization.

harness: Check cosine normalization along feature dimension, patch matching and batch reduction.
Teacher must receive no gradient; student and projection must receive gradients.
Mutants: detach student instead of teacher; normalize across tokens; compare mean pooled features instead of matched patches.
candidates.scope_note: New training principle for diffusion representations. Do not require DINOv2/DiT checkpoints or claim ImageNet speedup from toy.

candidates.title: One Step Diffusion via Shortcut Models
modules: Compose two short steps into a long-step bootstrap target
Joint flow-matching and shortcut loss
Step-size-conditioned sampling

toy.description: Use an analytic 2D curved flow or tiny mixture; compare one large shortcut against two smaller steps with fixed seeds.

harness: Second model call must use predicted intermediate state and time t+d.
Target average, step-size doubling and stop-gradient must agree with an explicit oracle.
Mutants: interpolate the second state from ground truth; forget averaging; keep target gradients; reuse time t.
candidates.scope_note: Distinct from MeanFlow and Progressive Distillation: one network conditioned on step size with recursive self-consistency. Paper figures explain geometry, but no verified released 2D toy benchmark.

candidates.title: Simplifying, Stabilizing and Scaling Continuous-time Consistency Models
modules: TrigFlow data/noise and velocity parameterization
Continuous-time consistency tangent via JVP
Stabilized tangent target

toy.description: Analytic linear or tiny nonlinear denoiser on 2D data; compare exact directional derivative with JVP and finite differences.

harness: Check cosine/sine endpoint conventions and the data-standard-deviation scale.
Compare JVP against analytic derivative away from boundaries; test stability near boundary times.
Mutants: omit time tangent; swap sine/cosine; omit sigma_d; allow target-gradient leakage.
candidates.scope_note: Existing Consistency paper remains the prerequisite; this candidate should focus on continuous-time derivative and stabilization, not duplicate the existing basic consistency loss.

candidates.title: Restructuring Vector Quantization with the Rotation Trick
modules: Nearest-codebook assignment
Rotation-and-rescaling surrogate with stop-gradient

toy.source: Paper Fig. 2 (16 codebook vectors; two 2D functions), Fig. 3 and Algorithm 1
toy.description: Reproduce the 2D gradient-field comparison between STE and the rotation trick; this is an explicit paper illustration, not a claimed full image-training reproduction.

harness: Forward result equals the chosen codebook vector; backward gradient follows the frozen scaled rotation.
Check gradient angle and norm against an explicit small rotation matrix.
Mutants: ordinary STE; omit norm scaling; differentiate through the rotation; transpose the rotation.
candidates.scope_note: An especially good harness stress test: checking forward values alone cannot distinguish correct code from a wrong gradient estimator. Specify zero-norm and antiparallel behavior before publishing.

candidates.title: Differential Transformer
modules: Difference of two separately normalized attention maps
Per-head normalization and lambda parameterization

toy.description: Tiny causal sequence with a shared distractor; visualize signed attention and common-mode cancellation.

harness: Identical maps and lambda=1 must cancel before normalization.
Test separate softmax, causal masking, head independence and gradients of lambda.
Mutants: softmax(A1-lambda*A2); add instead of subtract; mask only one branch; normalize across heads.
candidates.scope_note: Reuse ordinary attention as a prerequisite and supply projections where appropriate. Do not equate negative attention with a probability distribution.

candidates.title: SVDQuant: Absorbing Outliers by Low-Rank Component for 4-Bit Diffusion Models
modules: Smoothing transform that preserves a linear layer
Low-rank SVD branch plus quantized residual reconstruction

toy.source: Paper Fig. 2 and decomposition discussion in Sec. 3
toy.description: Small matrix with controlled singular outliers; show residual range and reconstruction error with and without a high-precision low-rank branch.

harness: Before quantization, smoothing and low-rank decomposition must reconstruct the original linear result.
Test rank zero/full rank and fixed quantization grids, scales, rounding and clipping.
Mutants: quantize the low-rank branch; quantize original weights instead of residual; invert smoothing on wrong side; add branch twice.
candidates.scope_note: CPU problem covers numerical algorithm only. Fused Nunchaku kernel performance requires a separate GPU challenge and is not implied by passing CPU tests.

candidates.title: Block Diffusion: Interpolating Between Autoregressive and Diffusion Language Models
modules: Clean/noisy block diffusion attention mask
Block-conditional masked denoising loss

toy.source: Appendix B.6, Fig. 3: sequence length L=6 and block size 2; Fig. 4 gives masking code
toy.description: Render and reproduce the exact 12x12 combined clean/noisy attention mask; extend to a tiny token sequence for denoising.

harness: Noised tokens may attend same noisy block and strictly previous clean blocks.
Clean tokens may attend current/prior clean blocks but no noisy tokens.
Mutants: allow same clean block to noisy query; use token-causal mask within a block; permit future blocks; swap clean/noisy quadrants.
candidates.scope_note: Strong original small example and meaningful leak tests; distinct from current continuous diffusion modules. Specify arbitrary-length tail-block behavior.

candidates.title: Adjoint Matching: Fine-tuning Flow and Diffusion Generative Models with Memoryless Stochastic Optimal Control
modules: Backward lean-adjoint recurrence
Detached adjoint-matching regression objective

toy.description: Analytic linear drift and quadratic terminal reward in one or two dimensions with a supplied trajectory; compare adjoint recurrence with a closed-form reference.

harness: Check terminal reward-gradient sign, reverse-time order and transpose in Jacobian-vector operations.
Trajectory and target adjoint are detached while fine-tuned velocity receives gradients.
Mutants: use trainable-control Jacobian instead of base drift; forward-time integration; omit noise scaling; backpropagate through sampled path.
candidates.scope_note: Advanced bridge between generative models and reward fine-tuning. Keep memoryless noise schedule and endpoint convention explicit; no verified original small toy was located.

candidates.title: In-Place Test-Time Training
modules: Chunkwise MLP fast-weight apply/update
Exclusive prefix-scan implementation with document resets

toy.description: Small synthetic key-value chunks with supplied NTP-aligned target tensors; compare sequential and scan implementations.

harness: Current chunk must use weights before that chunk update.
Match exclusive-prefix scan to sequential oracle; reset fast weights at document boundaries.
Mutants: inclusive cumsum; update before apply; wrong V-transpose-Z order; omit resets.
candidates.scope_note: Not the older similarly named TTT paper. Supplying targets isolates the fast-weight core; generating NTP targets needs an additional careful chunk-boundary/causality contract.

candidates.title: ParaRNN: Unlocking Parallel Training of Nonlinear RNNs for Large Language Models
modules: Assemble nonlinear recurrence residuals and Jacobians
Newton correction via associative parallel reduction

toy.source: Paper Sec. 2, Algorithm 1-2 and Appendix A
toy.description: Short scalar or diagonal-state nonlinear RNN; compare Newton-scan output with exact sequential unrolling.

harness: Test linear case, controlled contractive nonlinear case and non-power-of-two sequence lengths.
Compare residual decrease and converged output to sequential oracle.
Mutants: compose affine updates in reverse order; wrong residual sign; omit first-state boundary; reuse stale Jacobians.
candidates.scope_note: Paper concerns numerical parallelization. CPU toy demonstrates correctness, not the reported GPU speedup; do not assume three iterations suffice for every RNN.

candidates.title: DiffusionNFT: Online Diffusion Reinforcement with Forward Process
modules: Implicit positive/negative velocity policies
Reward-weighted dual flow-matching objective

toy.description: Tiny 2D samples with a simple bounded reward and frozen old velocity field; inspect positive versus negative update directions.

harness: Check reward endpoints r=0, r=1 and neutral r=0.5 with analytically known gradients.
Freeze old velocity and correctly broadcast per-sample rewards.
Mutants: omit negative loss; use same sign for both policies; swap beta and 1/beta; allow old-model gradients.
candidates.scope_note: Useful bridge from GRPO/OPD family to diffusion alignment; separate from PPO-like trajectory likelihood methods. Toy is adapted, not an original paper benchmark.

candidates.title: Large Language Diffusion Models
modules: 随机 masking 与仅对被 mask 位置计算的加权交叉熵
按置信度选择位置的迭代 unmasking
分块半自回归采样中的已知上下文保护

toy.source: 论文方法与官方 generate.py；不是原论文 8B 实验复现
toy.description: 用短序列、小词表和固定 logits oracle 显示从全 mask 到完整序列的采样轨迹。

harness: 杀掉在所有位置算 loss、漏掉 mask 概率权重的实现
杀掉覆盖 prompt/已确定 token、top-k 选错轴和步数余额分配错误的实现
固定模型输出与随机源，验证每步恰好开放规定数量的位置
candidates.scope_note: 已核官方节目 decision=Accept (oral)。填补现有连续 diffusion 到离散语言 diffusion 的缺口；优先拆采样和目标函数，不复现 8B 训练。

candidates.title: LoRA-One: One-Step Full Gradient Could Suffice for Fine-Tuning Large Language Models, Provably and Efficiently
modules: 对负 full gradient 做 SVD 的谱初始化
奇异值平方根拆分为两侧低秩因子
初始化与 alpha/sqrt(rank) 缩放后的有效更新

toy.description: 小型线性回归矩阵，用不同奇异谱比较随机初始化和梯度谱初始化；属于教学改编。

harness: 杀掉 SVD 用正梯度、遗漏 sqrt(singular values)、取错奇异子空间的实现
检查 A@B 的乘积和子空间而不逐元素比较 SVD 向量，避免符号非唯一误判
杀掉 alpha/r 与该论文 alpha/sqrt(r) 混用的实现
candidates.scope_note: 已核官方 decision=Accept (oral)。区别于已有 LoRA 的普通 BA forward；论文新版 arXiv 标题有变化，目录引用 ICML 录用版本。

candidates.title: Inductive Moment Matching
modules: 多粒子 kernel moment matching / MMD 目标
s < r < t 的 induction bootstrap target
stop-gradient 分支与一步/多步 sampler

toy.description: 二维 Gaussian mixture 的少步生成；MMD 既展示分布差异也提供确定的小张量单元题，不声称是原论文 toy。

harness: 杀掉只匹配 batch mean、不使用 pairwise kernel 的退化实现
杀掉 target 未 detach 或两侧均 detach 的实现
验证时间边界、粒子排列不变性、选定估计器的 diagonal 约定
candidates.scope_note: 已核官方 decision=Accept (oral)。官方 event abstract 残留旧名称 MMSD，题名与正式论文均为 IMM；不将其混写成 DMD 或普通 Consistency loss。

candidates.title: Normalizing Flows are Capable Generative Models
modules: 严格自回归 affine flow 与 log-Jacobian
逐位置 inverse 和正逆一致性
跨 flow block 反转自回归方向

toy.description: 二维点云或 4 个 patch 的小 flow，可视化密度变换；属于缩小后的教学模型。

harness: forward/inverse round-trip 和 autograd Jacobian 对照
杀掉 logdet 符号、affine scale 漏 exp、causal shift 泄露当前位置的实现
杀掉 direction reversal 未在 inverse 撤销的实现
candidates.scope_note: 已核官方 decision=Accept (oral)。是 normalizing flow，区别于题库已有 flow matching。题目无需大模型 checkpoint。

candidates.title: MaxSup: Overcoming Representation Collapse in Label Smoothing
modules: 把 Label Smoothing 拆成 CE 与 logit regularizer
CE + alpha * (max(logits) - mean(logits))
正确/错误分类时的梯度作用比较

toy.description: 三分类固定 logits 和二维簇小分类器，比较 misclassified sample 的更新；为教学改编。

harness: 故意构造 top-1 != ground-truth，杀掉照搬 label smoothing 的实现
杀掉 max probability 代替 max logit、漏 mean logit、重复加入 smoothing 的实现
测试 logits 常数平移不变性和非 tie 样本梯度
candidates.scope_note: 已核官方 decision=Accept (oral)。短小、核心清楚、无需外部模型，适合成为易到中等难度题。

candidates.title: KVzip: Query-Agnostic KV Cache Compression with Context Reconstruction
modules: 从 context reconstruction attention 提取原 cache 的重要性
跨 query positions 与 GQA groups 的 max 聚合
按预算筛选并同步 gather K/V 与原始位置

toy.description: 两层多头短序列 attention，用同一个压缩 cache 回答两种固定 query；只演示算法，不声称复现论文延迟提升。

harness: 杀掉 max 换 mean、GQA 聚合轴错误、未切出原 context keys 的实现
杀掉 K/V 不同索引、压缩后错误重编号 RoPE 位置的实现
测试 0/full budget 和排序稳定性
candidates.scope_note: 已核官方 decision=Accept (oral)。与现有 FlashAttention 不重复，侧重 KV cache eviction。先固定原 NeurIPS 算法版本，不自动混入 2026 Fast KVzip 更新。

candidates.title: Chebyshev Policies and the Mountain Car Problem: Reinforcement Learning for Low-Dimensional Control Tasks
modules: 稳定递推 Chebyshev basis
多变量 tensor-product policy 与状态归一化
在 MountainCarContinuous 中计算轨迹 return/regret

toy.source: 论文 Sections 4–5 与官方 repo；https://arxiv.org/html/2605.22305v3
toy.description: 原生 MountainCarContinuous-v0 低维控制实验，可复用其环境与低阶 policy，缩小训练 budget 并固定初始状态。

harness: 杀掉把 Chebyshev 写成普通 x^k、tensor-product 少交叉项的实现
测试 T0/T1/端点及可微性，避免只用 arccos 在端点导致 NaN 梯度
状态缩放和动作范围检查；最优性/完整训练结果不当作单元判分
candidates.scope_note: 官方 2026 JSON decision=Accept (spotlight)，同名 poster 为 /virtual/2026/poster/63070；官网另有 oral event。按录用级别标 Spotlight，不仅凭 /oral 路径升级 Oral。非常契合原生 toy 的用户需求。

candidates.title: Delving into Muon and Beyond: Deep Analysis and Extensions
modules: 谱变换 U Sigma^p V^T (p=0,1/4,1/2,1)
coupled Newton iteration 的小矩阵实现
比较 momentum update 与 RMS-normalized update 上的谱压缩

toy.source: 论文与作者官方 optimizer 代码
toy.description: 对预设奇异谱的矩阵做谱压缩，增加条件数不同的二次问题优化；教学改编。

harness: 用 SVD oracle 检查不同 p，杀掉始终返回 UV^T 的实现
矩形矩阵、尺度、零矩阵及迭代精度检查
杀掉 RMS preconditioning 次序错误或把谱归一化当逐元素幂的实现
candidates.scope_note: 官方 decision=Accept (spotlight)；poster URL 不等于普通 Poster。与已上线 GLM-5 MuonSplit 部分重叠，因此次优先；只有保留谱幂族和 coupled iteration 才有新增价值。

candidates.title: MuonSSM: Orthogonalizing State Space Models for Sequence Modeling
modules: 对低秩 input injection 应用 Newton–Schulz conditioning
memory + momentum coupled recurrence
block-affine recurrence 的串行/scan 等价性

toy.source: 论文 Section 3 与 Appendix B Algorithm 1；https://arxiv.org/html/2606.30461v1
toy.description: 短序列 associative recall 或合成 k/v 写入，对照状态更新及梯度传播；教学改编。

harness: 杀掉对 recurrent transition matrix 而非 input injection 做 NS 的实现
杀掉漏 momentum state、时刻对齐错误、scan 组合顺序错误的实现
检查 rank-one 注入仍 rank-one，梯度不能仅凭相同前向范数验证
candidates.scope_note: 官方 decision=Accept (spotlight)，同名 poster 为 /virtual/2026/poster/65102；另安排 oral talk。与 Kimi KDA 接近但核心在记忆写入的几何条件化。宜放在基本 SSM/DeltaNet 后面。

candidates.title: ConceptAttention: Diffusion Transformers Learn Highly Interpretable Features
modules: concept stream 单向读取 image/concept tokens
在 attention output space 构造 concept saliency maps
跨层 saliency 聚合

toy.description: 固定 patch/concept embeddings 的 4x4 彩色块图，以小型 attention 展示 concept maps。真实图像 demo 后续可用离线缓存特征。

harness: 加入 concept 前后 image/prompt 输出必须不变，杀掉双向信息污染
杀掉用原始 QK attention map 冒充 output-space saliency 的实现
检查 softmax 轴与跨层平均，以及 concept 顺序置换等变性
candidates.scope_note: 已核官方 decision=Accept (oral)。不要求用户下载 Flux。曾在 CVPR workshop 获奖，但此处仅标 ICML 主会 Oral，避免混淆。

candidates.title: Representation Entanglement for Generation: Training Diffusion Transformers Is Much Easier Than You Think
modules: image latent 与 semantic class token 同时间噪声插值
token 拼接与两路预测目标
推理时从噪声联合生成 latent 与 semantic token

toy.description: 二维混合分布加一维语义表示的 joint denoising，保留同步时间与双路目标，属于教学模型。

harness: 杀掉两路用不同时间、只对图像加噪、忽略 semantic target 的实现
推理不能偷偷读取 clean image 的 class token
同一时间不等于同一份噪声，分别验证两路传入 noise 与 broadcast
candidates.scope_note: 已核官方 decision=Accept (oral)。准确简称为 REG，不是 REPA-E。完整图像训练昂贵，先做局部目标与 joint sampler。

candidates.title: A Clean Slate for Offline Reinforcement Learning
modules: TD3-AWR 的 critic bootstrap target
advantage-weighted actor regression
固定离线数据、禁止额外在线更新的 evaluator

toy.description: 低维连续动作离线数据集或短链 MDP，小型 actor/critic；先检验公式，后增加固定数据的短训练。

harness: 杀掉 terminal bootstrap、target gradient 泄露和 critic 聚合错误
advantage 权重应随 action quality 单调变化；检查 actor/critic 的梯度隔离
短训练与评估固定轨迹和 seeds，不用在线调参后的结果作为离线算法成绩
candidates.scope_note: 已核官方 decision=Accept (oral)。这篇方法为 Unifloral、TD3-AWR、MoBRAC，不能写成 FQL。整篇更偏框架与评估协议，须锁定作者某个明确算法版本后才做题，优先级低于目标公式更独立的候选。

candidates.title: MoGe: Unlocking Accurate Monocular Geometry Estimation for Open-Domain Images with Optimal Training Supervision
modules: ROE scale + z-shift alignment：分段线性断点搜索与截断加权 L1 目标
局部球邻域的多尺度独立对齐损失

toy.description: 小型点云加入已知尺度、z平移和少量异常点，比较正确对齐与普通L2对齐；不需要视觉主干。

harness: 小N全断点枚举独立oracle核最优目标值
掩码、异常点、退化深度、尺度/平移不变性
局部邻域选择与不同球半径边界
candidates.scope_note: 重点是论文独有ROE几何对齐；固定CVPR 2025版本，勿误用仓库后来MoGe-2/3。属于核心模块复现，不要求图像到3D完整模型。

candidates.title: Improving Diffusion Inverse Problem Solving with Decoupled Noise Annealing
modules: 条件后验能量与Langevin更新
denoise → posterior sample → re-noise 的解耦退火步

toy.description: 论文Figure 4、Appendix G已有二维Gaussian-mixture逆问题及采样轨迹；正式制作时逐项对照源码核测量公式、观测值和图示。

harness: 固定传入噪声核单步更新和噪声系数
解析Gaussian后验作独立数值oracle
二维原生toy核分布距离、模式占比与跨seed稳定性
candidates.scope_note: 增加inverse-problem/posterior-sampling知识点，与已有无条件DDPM/DDIM题不同；不以大图FID或完整MRI重建作为CPU判题门槛。

candidates.title: Go-with-the-Flow: Motion-Controllable Video Diffusion Models Using Real-Time Warped Noise
